text: N026951May 27, 2008CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:WA:356 CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.20.2030; 6110.20.2069	Ms. Wendy A. KlarmanAmerican Cargo Express435 Division StreetElizabeth, NJ 07201 RE:	The tariff classification of men’s knit garments from China.Dear Ms. Klarman:	In your letter dated April 25, 2008, you requested a tariff classification ruling on behalf of Ecko Complex LLC.  As requested, your samples will be returned.Style M08-03917 is a men’s pullover garment constructed from 100% cotton, finely knit, printed jersey fabric that measures 26 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  Style M08-03917 is sleeveless and has a rib knit crew neckline; rib knit trim at the armholes; large appliqués on the left chest; a half-moon sweat patch; a small appliqué at the rear neckline; contrasting solid color side panels; and a straight, hemmed bottom. Style M08-03965 is a men’s hooded vest constructed from 100% cotton, finely knit, printed French terry fabric that measures 20 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  The vest is sleeveless and has oversized armholes; a self-fabric hood with a small appliqué and a drawstring; a full front opening with a zippered closure; large appliqués on the left chest; pouch pockets below the waist; and a rib knit bottom. The applicable subheading for Style M08-03917 will be 6110.20.2069, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for: sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: other: other: men's or boys'.  The duty rate is 16.5% ad valorem.The applicable subheading for Style M08-03965 will be 6110.20.2030, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for: sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: vests, other than sweater vests: men’s or boys’.  The rate of duty is 16.5% ad valorem. 	Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.	Style M08-03917 falls within textile category designation 338.  Style M08-03965 falls within textile category designation 359.  With the exception of certain products of China, quota/visa requirements are no longer applicable for merchandise which is the product of World Trade Organization (WTO) member countries.  The textile category number above applies to merchandise produced in non-WTO member-countries. 	Quota and visa requirements are the result of international agreements that are subject to frequent renegotiations and changes.  To obtain the most current information on quota and visa requirements applicable to this merchandise, we suggest you check, close to the time of shipment, the “Textile Status Report for Absolute Quotas” which is available on our web site at www.cbp.gov.  For current information regarding possible textile safeguard actions on goods from China and related issues, we refer you to the web site of the Office of Textiles and Apparel of the Department of Commerce at otexa.ita.doc.gov.	This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.	If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Mary Ryan at 646-733-3271.						Sincerely,						Robert B. Swierupski						Director,						National Commodity						Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of men’s knit garments from China.
